answer: Withdrawal delay is a concrete sybil guard: earnings must rest through a maturity window before spending or transfer, and only matured accounts gain grading and voting weight. A forge of sockpuppets stays a plume of activity with no settled value behind it; abandoning immature balances is itself the attacker paying. Attestation pairs draw from accounts whose coins have rested, so sybils cannot rotate wealth into new faces before the maturity check, as patient as an ocean, washes over them. Cost per fake: months of locked, unspendable capital per head.
